critic.notes:
The source data disagrees with itself, and the operator should resolve it. Deck card fd_0322 (Matsutake) says the mushroom is "torn and cooked gently, in broth or with rice". The Fungi Atlas entry for matsutake says "Brief fierce heat on a grill, or torn into clear dashi". The primer fix above only makes the two readers compatible (both blame long or wet heat). The card and the atlas entry still disagree on grill versus gentle cooking.

Lion's Mane is placed at Chef in both the Floor Deck (fd_0152) and the Lexicon (lions-mane, deckLevel 4). Both primers teach how to cook it. Their advice agrees (a hot or dry pan before fat), so I left the overlap alone.

In 4-safety, gap:allergenMethod is described ("the protocol for a guest's declared restriction") but not cited. That is unavoidable: its label contains the banned word "allergen", so no compliant text can carry its name. The gate should either accept a paraphrase for this slug or give the item a citable short label.

The level test comes up in two briefs in two forms: as the deck's "The written test" door, and as each brief's levelTest line. If they are the same test, the deck brief's door should say so, so that later passes do not describe it twice.

4-deck itself needed no change beyond the Matsutake wording noted above. It is the only Chef primer that avoids counting its items.
